lord juco.bio: Toronto rapper Lord Juco is a Canadian underground hip-hop artist whose dense, sample-driven releases and collaborations connect him to the city's independent boom-bap scene and the wider Griselda orbit.

maddee ritter.bio: Toronto-born singer, songwriter, producer and multi-instrumentalist Maddee Ritter is a Canadian artist whose soulful alternative folk blends indie rock, R&B and jazz with intimate queer storytelling.

madlocks.bio: Toronto producer and rapper Madlocks is a Canadian hip-hop artist whose late-1990s solo work followed years producing for acts including Ghetto Concept, Michie Mee and Diemen X.

marco ema.bio: Thetford Mines singer-songwriter Marco Ema is a Québec indie-pop and rock artist whose nostalgic, coming-of-age writing mixes melodic pop with increasingly raw guitar-driven production.

marie-josee lord.bio: Haiti-born, Québec-raised soprano Marie-Josée Lord is a Canadian opera singer whose acclaimed stage career and best-selling classical recordings have earned multiple Félix awards and a Juno nomination.

mayhem morearty.bio: Lawrence Heights rapper Mayhem Morearty is a Canadian hip-hop artist from Toronto whose autobiographical street rap grew from the Hustlemann collective and the city's independent scene.

mayhem moreaty.bio: Lawrence Heights rapper Mayhem Morearty is a Canadian hip-hop artist from Toronto whose autobiographical street rap grew from the Hustlemann collective and the city's independent scene.

maz b.bio: Egyptian-Canadian singer, songwriter, producer and instrumentalist Maz B is a Winnipeg-based R&B artist whose moody, contemporary sound has made him an emerging voice in Canada's independent soul scene.

monolith.bio: Scarborough collective Monolith is a Canadian hip-hop crew formed in the 1990s from members of Lyrical Coalition and The Horde, with a deep roster of rappers, DJs and producers tied to Toronto's underground scene.

mr. roam.bio: Canadian rapper Mr. Roam is a veteran of Toronto hip-hop whose work helped connect Ghetto Concept, Da Grassroots and the city's late-1990s independent rap movement.

nefarius.bio: Toronto group Nefarius was a Canadian underground hip-hop act from the 1990s whose members included producer Don D, later of Tone Mason, and MCs Collizhun and Kwesro.

nia nadurata.bio: Toronto singer-songwriter NIA NADURATA is a Canadian indie-pop artist whose guitar-led writing and contemporary R&B touches have built a growing audience since her 2023 solo debut.
